caption_L1: Here a area plot is titled Population in China from 1990 to 2019 , by age group (in millions). The y-axis plots 0-14 years while the x-axis plots Year.
caption_L2L3: Population of 0-14 year olds in China increased slightly between 1990 and 1995, from approximately 320 million to 325 million, before steadily decreasing until 2010 when the population of 0-14 year olds hit roughly 225 million. Since then, population has started to slowly increase again.
